purpose: Define the minimal necessary starting state and input fixtures for a valid Clean Room Phase 9.13 certification run.

required_inputs.description: The initial user prompt and requirements describing the creative intent.

agent_responsibilities.description: Agent must assemble and write this manifest using audio-tools-mcp and media-sources-mcp.
Agent must execute analyze_voiceover and format the resulting timings into this structured file.
Agent must generate the full creative plan by correlating 00_answers.md with 04_timings.json.
Agent must translate the master_plan.md into the rigorous 05_blueprint.json specification, adhering strictly to the Logical Asset ID contract.

pipeline_responsibilities.description: Generated implicitly by scripts/generators/materialize_project.py during the Asset Gate.

invariants.no_manual_generation: Other than the Agent acting autonomously through tools, NO human intervention is allowed to generate timings, manifests, or blueprints.
invariants.no_llm_hallucination: Timings MUST NOT be hallucinated by an LLM; they must strictly derive from MCP audio analysis output.
invariants.no_physical_paths: Assets must be passed by Logical Asset IDs between stages.
